dedupe_keys.name: madrid urban planning catalogue of protected buildings

description: Dirección General de Planificación Estratégica, Madrid City Council publishes the buildings catalogued for protection under the urban plan, with the protection level, degree of protection and catalogue number, downloaded as a zipped geodata file, with the full information and services in the city geoportal and a map service viewer. Coverage: the city of Madrid; the portal lists daily update frequency and the record was last modified on 2026-07-29. Format and access: ZIP, downloadable without registration from the Madrid City Council open data portal (datos.madrid.es). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0, legal code in Spanish on the portal); cost: free. Caveats: the page says the geoportal holds the complete information and services, the zipped file was not opened, and the fields beyond level, degree and catalogue number are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: heritage-constraint layers for retrofit, renovation and exposure analyses of the building stock and for seismic or flood loss assessments that treat protected buildings separately. Related catalogue records: Arbolado en parques y zonas verdes de Madrid (municipal tree inventory, yearly files) (data-madrid-arbolado-parques-zonas-verdes); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
